purpose: Prevent duplicate prerequisite validation and immutable operator execution when M3-C-H work moves across chats, reviews, or operator sessions.
non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
reporting-only reuse of the pinned prerequisite chain
invalidators: a new M3-C-H tree or exact head requiring its own validation
artifact loss, corruption, expiry without retained immutable copy, or SHA-256 mismatch
validation workflow, pinned dependency, focused scope, or forward-registration change
base ancestry no longer containing b717b676ec84fd157eabf5b0a947f68c1c6617eb
new_tree_rule: M3-C-H receives one new full-suite validation only for its final forward-registered exact head. Discovery, defect-fix discovery, and registration-only heads are not merge evidence and must not be manually rerun.
activation_rule: M3-C-H must merge with both reviewed active pins absent. Pinning an implementation head or authorization digest belongs only to a separate M3-C-I exact-reviewed change.
next_chat_rule: Inspect this pin and EXACT_HEAD_VALIDATION_REUSE_LEDGER.json before scheduling tests or operator commands. Reuse the immutable prerequisite evidence when policy conditions still match.
